review_scope: Read-only integrity review of five correction processing helpers. No scientific re-review of other authored groups; no maintained data writes.

findings.finding: Validation freshness binds only proposal ID and after hash, not the validated full proposal metadata. A promotion destination change is accepted by the current equality guard.
findings.remediation: Require full validation payload equality with current P, or exact canonical proposal manifest hash, before native authoring.
findings.control: Pure in-memory comparison of unchanged after bytes with changed destination reproduces accepted stale metadata.

findings.finding: Native author accepts schema and partonomy PASS without checking introduced active identifier collisions. validate_proposals writes those PASS fields even when its final nonzero exit is caused by an identifier collision.
findings.remediation: Assert active_identifier_collisions.introduced is empty and bind any overall validation status or successful process receipt.
findings.control: Static inspection of producer receipt and exit predicate against consumer assertions.

findings.finding: Cross-shard matching ignores destination_owner_path, so an unmapped-to-mapped promotion can collide with another new or edited destination path while using a different identifier and evade matching.
findings.remediation: Record source and destination paths on both sides and flag any intersection.
findings.control: Pure in-memory old condition misses differing identifiers sharing a promoted destination.

findings.finding: Owner-reference dictionary comprehension silently takes the last SHA for an owner.
findings.remediation: Assert identical SHA across every occurrence before constructing unique refs.
findings.control: Static inspection; downstream structural audit may catch inconsistent records, but dependency producer itself must not erase them.

findings.finding: Destination path is not restricted to direct maintained mapped/unmapped YAML locations or checked against candidate mapping status.
findings.remediation: Validate owner/destination path grammar and mapped-state directory; preserve before owner path on promotions.
findings.control: Static inspection; current payloads not alleged to have invalid destinations.

findings.finding: The native inspector returns target metadata but does not hash the targets specification automatically. Current authoring reads targets.json without comparing it with inspect.targets, allowing selector/owner metadata to drift after inspection.
findings.remediation: Include targets.json as an explicit input and require equality with inspect.targets before authoring.
findings.control: Read scripts/record_review.py inspect_source and validate_review; actual target file bytes are correctly hashed, but current target metadata is not.

accepted_behaviors: Exact per-group reviewed input hashes, author separation, complete case ID set, frozen case hashes and source identity, bidirectional proposal backlinks and actual old owner bindings are enforced by assembly.
All 188 cases are reassessed; all 159 predecessor no-proposal cases are counted from predecessor decisions. This check is coverage, not a substitute for scientific reassessment.
Identical shared evidence is deduplicated only on full object equality; conflicting provenance fails. This covers the shared case60 thiamine source capture.
Mapped/unmapped maintained file contents are native inspection target inputs and later source hashes are checked. No separate owner-byte freshness hole was found.
Accepting review_status PASS and case status supported_with_stated_limits with zero or empty open_findings is a legitimate exact-format adaptation of the immutable materials review.
Proposals remain isolated; native verdict needs_curation and explicit exclusions prevent whole-owner or export approval.
additional_recommendations: Native promotion targets and actions should explicitly carry destination_owner_path alongside the original before-guarded owner.
Cross-shard snapshot should mark missing after-capture files as unverified, rather than leaving an unexplained null identifier.
Severity assignment should reflect newly identified semantic repairs, not only the fixed legacy proposal ID list.
limits: Static review plus bounded in-memory guard demonstrations; no full adversarial helper execution yet.
No general exhaustive repository absence claim made. Explicit maintained directory reads and frozen shard paths are used by the helpers.
Current script snapshots are preserved so later remediation can be reviewed without erasing this finding history.
